metadata.title: Monochromatic Urban Portrait with Slab Serif Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic red-toned portrait of a male figure wearing sunglasses and jewelry, featuring bold, heavy slab-serif typography in the lower corners. The image uses a duotone-like effect where shadows are deep brown/black and highlights are saturated orange-red.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic red palette unifying subject and background
Heavyweight typography anchoring the bottom corners
High-contrast lighting emphasizing metallic textures of jewelry
Central figure positioning with a slight upward camera angle
coreInvariants: Deep black shadows with high contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, bright yellow-orange text in the bottom right corner acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face/sunglasses, moves down the arm to the jewelry, and finally rests on the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the background is a textured, flat red that blends with the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden Yellow (Typography and highlights on jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across the red spectrum with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid blues, greens, or cool tones
Limit to a triadic-adjacent palette of red, orange, and black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square terminals
letterConstructionRules: Small x-height relative to cap height
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard high-impact slab serif geometry
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary logo-like text in the bottom left uses a more stylized, condensed sans-serif to contrast the main slab serif.
graphicDevices: Light leak streaks on the right edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab terminals and geometric structure.
Provides the necessary blocky, industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man in sunglasses and a beanie, lit from the side to create deep shadows. Apply a heavy monochromatic red-orange duotone filter. Add film grain and vertical light leaks on the right side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold, uppercase slab-serif text in the bottom right corner in a golden-yellow color. Add a small black 'Parental Advisory' style box in the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly red, orange, and black?
Is the typography a heavy slab-serif?
Is the contrast high enough to obscure details in the shadows?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the dark background.
Check that the red tint covers 100% of the image area.
Verify the slab serifs are thick and rectangular.
Confirm the presence of film grain texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Red + High Contrast Portrait + Heavy Slab Serif Typography = Urban Album Aesthetic
